title: Evaluation questions (questions/questions.json; docs/earlier-work.md, The 12 questions; row 2.3)
description: One entry per evaluation question. The id names the concept session ($CONCEPTS/<id>/), the gold directory ($GOLD/<id>/) and the run keys (<id>-<condition>-r<repeat>). Changing a question's text invalidates its concept, gold and runs (docs/earlier-work.md, Questions).

id.description: q01..q99, also the concept session and gold directory name

category.description: corpus_wide: one reading, the answer spans many papers; ambiguous: more than one reasonable reading, the concept step proposes them

question.description: the question as the concept step and the gold builder see it

source.description: where the question comes from: an id in github.com/guptaaditya746/labelling questions/questions.json (e.g. nlp33), or 'own'

notes.description: how it was reworded from its source, and why
